changelog: Fixes music artist labels displaying [object Object] by reading modern Name/Id pairs and legacy strings. Uses artist-item and track-artist fallbacks when album artists are missing. Explicitly requests total catalog counts.
description: Adds an accessible CoverFlow browser to Jellyfin Web for existing media libraries. It uses Jellyfin metadata and images without modifying library data.
name: CoverFlow
overview: Browse Jellyfin libraries with a 3D CoverFlow interface.
